name: Booki
description: Booki — Agent-first Financial UI-SDK on Vercel UI SDK.

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @booki-aui/core build && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/primitives build && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/react build && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/styles build && pnpm build:frameworks && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/readiness build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/ensure-built.mjs && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/primitives typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/react typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/www typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/web --filter @booki-aui/vue --filter @booki-aui/svelte --filter @booki-aui/solid typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/readiness typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/example-ap-flow typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/example-crm typecheck
scripts.coverage: node scripts/ensure-built.mjs && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/core test:coverage && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/primitives test:coverage && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/react test:coverage
scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-built.mjs && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/core test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/primitives test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/react test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/styles test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/web test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/readiness test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/example-ap-flow test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/example-crm test && pnpm --filter agent-benchmark test && pnpm --filter @booki-aui/www test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm generate:frameworks && pnpm format
